QA test plan by role

Owner: engineering. Status: draft, October 2026. Covers the pilot scope first; every row maps to a workflow in docs/master/SEMESTER_WORKFLOW_CATALOG.md.

1. Test levels

LevelToolRunsCovers
UnitvitestEvery PRsemester-core logic, validators, formatters
Database / RLSSQL test harnessEvery PRPolicies per table and role
Componentvitest + Testing LibraryEvery PRStates, accessible names, keyboard
End to endPlaywrightEvery PR (smoke), nightly (full)Role journeys below
Accessibilityaxe + manualEvery PR (axe), each release (manual)See accessibility test plan
ExploratoryHumanBefore each pilot launchPilot paths with real institution config in staging

2. Test accounts

One synthetic account per role in staging, mapped through the test IdP: student, applicant, guardian, faculty, TA, advisor, registrar, finance, student affairs, IT/security, institution admin, Semester support operator, Semester executive. No real student data in any non-production environment.

3. Role journeys (end to end)

RoleJourneyMust pass
StudentSign in with SSO → onboarding → Today → registration readiness → resolve hold hand-off → enroll requestEach item shows its source; hold hand-off goes to registrar; nothing writes to SIS
StudentShare with advisor → revokeAdvisor sees only shared items; access ends immediately on revoke
StudentAsk Semester with a question containing a student IDBlocked; event logged; friendly message
StudentExport personal data → request deletionExport file complete; deletion request routed to the institution
GuardianAccept invitation → view shared items → expiryOnly chosen categories visible; access ends at expiry
FacultyPublish course AI policy → create assignment → release gradePolicy appears on student AI answers; release is two-step with preview
TAGrade within assigned sections onlyOther sections forbidden
AdvisorCaseload → check-in → referralOnly consented shares visible; referral status updates
RegistrarGrant override (two-person) → reconcile with SISSecond approver required; audit event before apply
FinanceView balance → payment plan requestNo payment handled by Semester; processor hand-off only
IT / securityConfigure SSO → role mapping → audit explorerChanges audited; break-glass needs reason and review
Institution adminFeature cohort on → kill switch offFeature disappears for the cohort within a minute
Semester supportOpen ticket → view tenant healthNo student table readable from /ops
Semester executiveExecutive overviewBusiness data only; no student records

4. Negative and security tests

  • Cross-tenant URL tampering for every role → forbidden and logged.
  • Expired session and revoked membership → signed out.
  • Rate limits on AI and auth endpoints.
  • Input validation: oversized fields, script injection in every text input.
  • Offline: queue a task offline, reconnect, verify single write (idempotency key).

5. Release entry and exit

GateCriterion
EntryAll PRs merged; staging deployed; seed data reset
ExitSmoke suite green; no open S1/S2; full e2e green within the last 24 h; accessibility checklist signed

6. Defect severity

SeverityExampleFix by
S1Data exposure across tenants; AI receives a recordStop release; fix now
S2SSO broken; wrong SIS data shownBefore release
S3One feature broken with workaroundNext release
S4CosmeticBacklog
